data.title: Pat Bradley: A lovely swing to remember
data.description: The swing that God gave Pat Bradley was a thing of beauty. It was a lovely rhythmic motion that never seemed to change, whatever club she was using. I found her practising at the Florida club she called home at the time. After a while, she spotted me watching her go through her practice routine and said hello, she caught my English accent and asked me many questions. I had always wanted to meet her as I had admired her swing ever since I saw it on TV.

data.title: Atletico sink Man Utd as Viking deny Bayern in Champions League
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Atletico Madrid beat Manchester United 2-0 in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday as the Red Devils continued their poor run, while Bayern Munich were held 3-3 in Norway by underdogs Viking Stavanger.

data.title: Young Om gives Thailand Olympic boost
data.description: Putthaphum Nakpaen has emerged as the best U23 BMX racer in Asia after a breakthrough World Cup campaign in China, giving Thailand a significant boost in its bid to qualify for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

data.title: Rangsan's Chonburi stint ends after 4 losses in row
data.description: Chonburi have parted company with head coach Rangsan Viwatchaichok and his assistant, Sinthaweechai Hathairattanakool, after a winless run of four Thai League 1 games this season.

data.title: Easy win for mixed duo as Ratchanok pulls out injured
data.description: Mixed doubles pair Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran advanced to the second round of the US$950,000 Denmark Open in Odense on Tuesday.

data.title: Buriram, Ratchaburi seek wins
data.description: Hosts Buriram United face a buoyant Beijing FC in the AFC Champions League Elite, with Thailand's two representatives both desperate to arrest troubling runs in the competition.

data.title: Pakistan detains hundreds from ex-PM Khan's party as protests falter
data.description: PESHAWAR (PAKISTAN) - Pakistani authorities have detained hundreds of members of Imran Khan's party, police officials said on Monday, as a protest movement in support of the jailed former prime minister appeared to falter.

data.title: Man City charges cloud hangs over Premier League season
data.description: LIVERPOOL, England - Manchester City emerged unscathed from a hostile reception at Anfield in their first match since a guilty verdict on widespread financial impropriety, but a 3-0 win over Liverpool highlighted the uncertainty that now surrounds the Premier League season.

data.title: Stars stacked, Philly now the team to beat
data.description: Now that the Philadelphia 76ers have acquired superstar Jaylen Brown and won the LeBron James free agency lottery, they are just about everyone's pick to notch their first NBA title in 43 years.

data.title: Leaders Buriram rally to sink Rayong at home
data.description: Buriram United came from behind to edge 10-man Rayong 3-2 in a pulsating Thai League 1 encounter at Chang Arena on Saturday night.

data.title: Ratchanok's title bid comes a cropper in Finland final
data.description: Ratchanok Intanon's hopes of winning her second World Tour title of the year and the 10th of her career ended in disappointment as the Thai ace fell to Mia Blichfeldt in the final of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Sunday.

data.title: Thai delegation off to Japan, aims for another 27-gold haul
data.description: The 265-member Thai national para team left for Japan on Sunday to participate in the 5th Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, from Oct 18-24.

data.title: Three Premier League talking points
data.description: LONDON - Manchester City gave a defiant response after being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules as the leaders romped to victory at Liverpool.

data.title: Man City shrug off uncertain future to beat 10-man Liverpool
data.description: LIVERPOOL - Manchester City shrugged off the threat of swingeing sanctions to beat 10-man Liverpool 3-0 in their first game since being found guilty on more than 100 charges of breaking Premier League financial rules.

data.title: All Blacks crush Aussies to retain Bledisloe Cup
data.description: AUCKLAND: Australia's hopes of wresting back the Bledisloe Cup ‌for the first time in a generation were crushed in familiar fashion in a comprehensive 50-19 loss to New Zealand at Auckland's Eden Park yesterday.

data.title: Premier League in 'limbo'                         as Man City case drags on
data.description: LONDON: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola said the lack of clarity over Manchester City's future after the club was found guilty of multiple breaches of financial rules was causing uncertainty throughout the Premier League.

data.title: Ekanit on the double as ten-man Ratchaburi hit Sukhothai fox six
data.description: Ratchaburi were reduced to 10 men in the first half but still cruised to a 6-0 win over Sukhothai FC in the Thai League 1 on Friday night, with Ekanit Panya scoring twice in front of the home crowd.

data.title: Thai star Ratchanok rallies to reach Artic Open final
data.description: Ratchanok Intanon staged a fightback to book her berth in the women's singles final of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Saturday.

data.title: A messy situation as City appeal clouds title race
data.description: The Premier League returns to action this week under a deep cloud of uncertainty and confusion following the Manchester City guilty verdict by an independent panel and the club's subsequent appeal.

data.title: Kunlavut leads Thai QF charge
data.description: Top seed Kunlavut Vitidsarn stayed on course for his second World Tour title this year after reaching the quarter-finals of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Thursday.

data.title: Port collapse as Persib strike twice late
data.description: Borzidar Bandovic began his reign as Port head coach with a defeat as his team went down to Persib Bandung 3-1 in the opening Group B game of the Asean Club Championship Shopee Cup at Thammasat Stadium on Thursday night.
